test.create_query: CREATE TABLE clamp_num (v UInt32, lo UInt32, hi UInt32, vf Float64, lof Float64, hif Float64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO clamp_num SELECT number % 65535, 10000, 50000, (number % 65535) * 1.5, 15000.0, 75000.0 FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(clamp(v, lo, hi)) FROM clamp_num
SELECT sum(clamp(vf, lof, hif)) FROM clamp_num
